_note: The brand page, 2026-09-06. Daniel wrote the copy: what a signet was, what it means here, and what the company is for. It is the only surface on the site that argues from the name rather than from the booking, so it carries no logistics, no configurations and no figures. Two edits to his draft, both to keep his own standing site laws: the em dash in the wax sentence became a comma (estate-wide em-dash ban), and 'fill a room' became 'fill the night' (the 2026-08-18 music-copy rule that bans 'room' outside green room and ballroom).
title: About Signet Artists
meta_description: A signet was a personal mark, pressed into wax to say who made a thing and that it was theirs. We think of it as the mark an artist leaves behind.
